description: This file defines the StockStatus class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation namespace. The class includes methods for managing stock statuses, such as add, edit, delete, and retrieve stock status data and descriptions in different languages, with caching mechanisms. It extends a system engine model and interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to stock status entities in an OpenCart administrative context.

classes.name: StockStatus
classes.description: Class for managing stock status entities in the OpenCart admin localization module, including CRUD operations and descriptions management.

methods.name: addStockStatus
methods.description: Inserts a new stock status entry for each language provided in the data array; also adds descriptions for additional languages. Returns the ID of the newly created stock status.

methods.name: editStockStatus
methods.description: Replaces existing stock status data for the specified ID with new descriptions for various languages; clears relevant caches.

methods.name: deleteStockStatus
methods.description: Deletes the stock status with the given ID from the database and clears cache.

methods.name: deleteStockStatusesByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all stock status descriptions corresponding to a specified language ID and clears cache.

methods.name: getStockStatus
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific stock status by ID, considering the current language.

methods.name: getStockStatuses
methods.description: Fetches a list of stock statuses, with optional pagination and order, utilizing caching.

methods.name: getTotalStockStatuses
methods.description: Returns the total count of stock statuses for the current language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a stock status in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a given stock status ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Fetches all stock status descriptions for a specific language ID.
